blocks.html: And as to the marks and scars imprinted on the eyes, forehead, hands and nails of the said du Tilh, prisoner, and formerly recognised on the body of Martin Guerre: it will be answered that a part of these signs, such as the warts on the hands, the drops of blood in the eye, and the sinking of the nail, are each proved by only one witness, and thus they are singular witnesses, who make no proof even though they were a thousand, each deposing to his own fact.
